newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares continue record breaking advance.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares continue record breaking advance.

text.p: Norwegian shares continued to advance strongly on Thursday led by positive momentum on other European markets and Wall Street and closed at the 13th all-time high of the year so far.
The Total share index climbed 0.93 percent to end the session at 1,057.55 points, slightly off an intrsday peak at 1,058.95 points. Turnover was 27 percent down from Wednesday at 1.01 billion crowns.
Dealers said much of the day's focus had been on real estate and high technology shares.
There was also late action in the offshore sector on reports that Kvaerner had beaten Aker Maritime in the bidding for the seven billion crown Aasgard B project.

An industry source told Reuters that Aasgard operator Statoil had proposed to its licence partners that Kvaerner be awarded the deal. "Statoil will make a decision at its board meeting today conditional of the approval of the licence partners," said the source. "Aker is close but for various reasons the contract will go to Kvaerner."
Aker Maritime closed 7.50 crowns, or seven percent, down at 95 crowns, while Kvaerner A ended 6.50 up at 309.50 crowns.
